sentences.text: Shri Ankesh Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Anil Upadhyay - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State
 Order

This is first application filed by applicant Satendra Kumar Saket under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.1014/2024 dated 22.12.2024 registered at Police Station Bargawa, District Singrauli, for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 108, 332(b), 69, 89 of BNS, 2023 and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 (as mentioned in the application).
The applicant is in jail since 29.12.2024.

This first regular bail application has been argued on the ground that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case and for this reliance has been placed on the testimony of prosecution witnesses, they include the parents and close relatives of deceased who have not supported the prosecution story on any of the counts of allegations.
It is, therefore, requested to allow this bail application.

Counsel for the State has opposed the bail application on the ground 2 MCRC-24767-2025 that there is a dying declaration of deceased in which she has categorically stated that she was sexually abused by applicant on the false promise of marriage and applicant was also on instrumental in ensuring her abortion.
It is submitted that statements on that aspect are yet to be recorded.
A request has been made to dismiss the application.
Counsel for both the sides have been heard and the case diary has been perused.
Having considered the facts mentioned in the case diary and the statements of material prosecution witnesses, but without commenting on merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.
